text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: metering-emitter-error x10 in us-west-2. Severity: P2. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2965432100

jessica: saw the pager. I'm on it. starting with emitter dashboards and queue depth.

lee: metrics show token-emitter downstream ack latency spiked at 02:03 UTC, retry backlog growing. overage flags firing for ~24k customers (mostly free-tier).

mike: running quick count compare between realtime and nightly agg: 
```
-- simplified check
SELECT sum(tokens) FROM realtime.emits WHERE minute >= '2026-03-15T01:50Z';
SELECT sum(tokens) FROM billing.cold_agg WHERE minute >= '2026-03-15T01:50Z';
```
realtime ~ 1.2B, cold_agg ~ 980M so ~22% delta.

amit: confirming — emitter retries were doubled after a recent rate limiter tweak. duplicates in the replay path are likely. I see a sustained 5xx -> retry loop in logs. sample: `emitter_v1 | send err: 502 | retry 3 | id: abc123`

tilly: is this causing customers to see overage flags?

lee: yes — the rule that raises overage flags watches rolling token totals from realtime counts. with the duplicate burst it's triggering thresholds. cs-kate we might need to pause notifications.

cs-kate: please pause automated overage emails asap. we'll hold until counts reconciled. I'll draft an outbound if this affects billed customers.

jessica: oncall handoff: @tilly will take lead for live mitigation, @amit stays on emitter rollback or config. I'll do comms triage and watch dashboards.

tilly: doing immediate mitigation: switching emitter traffic to fallback emitter-v2 (stateless path) and disabling aggressive client-side retry for 60m. commands: 
```
# toggle feature flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://featureflag.internal/toggle -d '{"flag":"emitter_v2_fallback","on":true}'
```

ops-bot: rollout started for emitter_v2_fallback in us-west-2. canary (5%) -> 100% in 3m.

mike: while rollout happens I pushed a quick dedupe query to the cold-agg pipeline to mark duplicates based on (customer_id,request_id). estimate: should cut duplicate tokens by ~18-20% in next batch run.

amit: note — the rate limiter change was deployed last night (PR #4123). adjusting it back to previous thresholds now.

tilly: fallback confirmed stable at 100%. ack latency down to baseline. overage flag rate dropping.

jessica: good. timeline so far: 02:03 spike -> pager 02:05 -> mitigation toggle finished 02:12 -> dedupe patch scheduled 02:20.

cs-kate: holding notifications. I'll prepare a short note for affected customers: "We saw inflated usage reports due to a telemetry duplication issue. We're reconciling counts and will not bill for the duplicated tokens." want to run it by legal before send.

lee: suggest running a reconciliation job comparing unique request_ids across realtime and cold_agg for the affected window before marking final counts. I have a query ready.

mike: kicked an adhoc reconciliation job. ETA 18m. rough numbers from quick pass show ~19.8% of tokens in window are duplicates.

amit: I'll open a follow-up PR to add idempotency keys in the emitter retry path so this doesn't recur. linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-duplicates

incidents-bot: Incident annotated: tags=[metering, emitter, billing, priority:P2], incident_url=https://redwood.internal/incidents/2965432100/summary

tilly: once reconciliation finishes, we should hold a short postmortem check-in. provisional owner: amit. action items: rollback rate-limiter change (in progress), add dedupe in agg, pause notifications (done), idempotency fix (PR planned).

jessica: oncall notes added. handing off primary responder to amit for follow-up. I'll monitor for any customer escalations.

cs-kate: thanks all. if reconciliation indicates billed customers were affected we will need to issue credits and a brief incident email. I'll coordinate with billing ops.

mike: reconciliation job complete: duplicates ~= 19.6% for 01:50-02:15 window. generating corrected usage file and submitting a backfill to billing pipeline. uploading to /internal/billing/backfills/2965432100.csv

ops-bot: backfill job accepted, id=bkfill-2965432100, queued for processing.

lee: monitoring shows overage flags cleared in 90% of impacted accounts; remaining are manual review because of unusual traffic patterns.

amit: PR #4178 opened for idempotency + rate-limit config guard. will request review from eng-runtime.

tilly: marking triage complete. leaving postmortem checklist in the thread. thanks for fast responses. :thumbsup:

jessica: adding postmortem owners and timeline to incidents tracker. closing pager.

cs-kate: drafting customer note now; will share for review in #customer-comms.

incidents-bot: Pager resolved. duration 00:45.

jessica: postmortem follow-up items added: 1) revert/risk-check deploys to avoid hidden retry loops, 2) add end-to-end test with emitter retries and dedupe, 3) block overage emails until reconciliation finishes in future incidents, 4) monitoring alert for emitter retry multiplier.

amit: thanks everyone. I'll take the postmortem and runbook updates.

cs-kate: leaving a note to billing-ops to check for any customer-initiated disputes.

lee: closing thread but will keep an eye on the dashboards for 24h.

jessica: good job team.
